input: Turn on the air purifiers in the store room.

contexts: Dust particles float visibly in the sunlight streaming through a small window, indicating a lack of air circulation in the room.
There is a lingering musty scent, typical of items stored for long periods, suggesting diminished air freshness.
An uncomfortable scratchiness in the throat and occasional sneezing suggest the air carries more irritants than usual.
The enclosed space feels stale and possibly humid, as evidenced by a slight discomfort in breathing.
Sensitive individuals might notice an itchiness in the eyes or a general feeling of heaviness in the air, pointing to below-optimal air quality.
